description: Session 44 and older annotation sets (input.annotationSets, the Session's config.annotationSets) with the Session's diagram mode, its saved feature catalog (projected to the fields the readers use), and its request records, and the annotation sets both readers must produce: a featureSpan target with one hash selector moves to a featureIdentity target in that mode when the record it binds is drawn without a crop, reverse complement, or rotation and the hash names exactly one catalog feature, in that record. migratedCount counts the moved targets; with none, the input is returned as saved. Expected outputs are JSON: a target field the saved target did not have is absent. A case with `fixture` is projected from that Session saved by first-parent main. Read by tests/test_session_compat.py (session_io.migrate_session_annotation_targets) and tests/web/feature-edit-migration.test.mjs (migrateSessionAnnotationTargets).
